events.title: Welcome to the Out of Order community hub
events.summary: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and drafting new products. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.You sign a contract at a venue and fill your vending machine from your stockroom.
